gen-gf-sniglet-gf-inclusive-sans: Soft-cornered and sure of itself, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back in. And Inclusive Sans brings round letters whose rims match their stems, so every curve stays open-ended and level-headed.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans reads like bent copper pipe, tubular strokes with c openings you can see through. Inria Sans keeps that going down a long page, while Sniglet up top holds its quiet, level beat without a single accent of weight.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-istok-web: Sniglet draws every stroke with no thick-thin modulation, its terminals stopping short of curling back in. Istok Web follows in rounded sans-serif letters with a clearly open side, so a long stretch of text feels approachable and modern.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-jost: Jost reads clean and broad-gapped, with one unit-width stroke throughout. Sniglet is the one to lean on for distinctive, commanding display, while the plain sans below simply carries the words.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-jura: Wire-thin steadiness meets a display face with attitude. Yet the strongest thing here is how Jura's s curves open wide at both ends while Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-k2d: K2D reads clean, its tube-like thickness holding through every bend. Sniglet takes the commanding, distinctive headline spot with its level beat, and the sans underneath lets its c terminals hang far from the bowl.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kanchenjunga: Terminals that stop short of curling back in give Sniglet its distinctive, commanding look. But Kanchenjunga does the steady work, with the line of a technical drafting pen and shapes that never clog at low resolution.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kantumruy-pro: Sniglet brings a distinctive, commanding look, with terminals that stop short of curling back in. And Kantumruy Pro lets a long stretch of text go down easily, its e opening clearly to the right with no hairlines or swells.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kodchasan: Round, bold-headed and unfussy, Sniglet carries the distinctive, commanding display work with a quiet, level beat. Kodchasan, the plain sans, simply stays clean.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-koho: KoHo keeps its wide c apertures open and tidy as a plain sans. Its strongest quality is how that clean text sits against Sniglet's flat, single-weight linework and its distinctive, commanding look.
